Subject: RE: Joint Evaluation Playbook — draft and quick sync (internal notes)

Internal — quick pass on Olivia's asks and proposed edits to the MAP seed.

Key edits I'm proposing in the GDoc (will apply and share link):
1) Add a short "Definition of Done" per milestone (tech validation: throughput and 95th pct latency; business acceptance: sample user scenarios with precision thresholds).
2) Insert a single-sheet test harness runbook (commands + sample curl + expected metrics) so Prospect's infra team can run without our engineers standing by.
3) Distinguish mandatory vs. optional acceptance checks (red/amber/green).
4) Assign internal owners for each milestone: Jasmine = integration/config, Monica = success/case studies, me = pilot infra & fallback policy.

Open question for you both: do we recommend a canary model (smaller model class) during the 10-day window to reduce blowouts? My preference is yes — include explicit rollback steps.

I'll put the first-pass edits in the GDoc by EOD and include a one-slide "decision cadence" (weekly checkpoints + a triage contact).

Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear timeline. I've seeded the live GDoc with the items Karthik mentioned and added a short test harness section (how to run our inference container with your sample file). Link below.

Quick summary of what I changed:
- Acceptance criteria: added perf targets (95th pct latency < 350ms for 512-token runs; embedding recall > 0.88 on provided test set).
- Week-by-week owner grid: week 0 = Prospect infra lead (setup), week 1 = integration + smoke tests (Redwood engineering + Prospect dev), week 2 = model evaluation + UX samples, week 3 = business acceptance and procurement prep.
- Canary policy: recommend starting on a quantized 8-bit variant during the 10-day validation; rollback steps are listed and include automatic fallback to a CPU-validated stub if GPU provisioning fails.

Meeting: I proposed a 30-min sync on Thu, 2026-11-26 at 10:00 PT. Please accept if that works — if not, propose two alternate 30-min windows.

GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAPseed-example (edit access granted to olivia@prospect.ai)
GSlides (timeline): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1CloseTimeline-example

Best,
